summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 (E2E test expansion and staging baselines) including cleanup helpers, media/streaming tests, batch download tests, and capturing live staging performance baselines with SDK load testing.
summary.outcome: Phase 34 completed with all 4 plans executed, PR #392 created and all 13 review threads resolved. Real 200-client sustained load baselines captured (11,174 ops, 0.17% error rate). BYO Pinata capacity ceiling test run but limited by free tier quota exhaustion.

repo: Staging Web3Auth init takes ~22.7s — the wallet button timeout in journey-timing.spec.ts needed to be raised from 20s to 45s for staging runs

Playwright config BASE_URL env var was not being respected — playwright.config.ts needed explicit process.env.BASE_URL override and conditional webServer block to skip local server startup when targeting staging

The staging API throttle bypass (X-Throttle-Bypass-Secret header) works correctly — the initial 429s during load testing were caused by running two load tests simultaneously against the same staging instance, not a bypass failure
SDK load test harness (tests/load/) does not load .env files by default — vitest requires explicit env sourcing (source .env before running) since vitest has no built-in dotenv loading
Pinata free tier storage limits are hit quickly when running capacity ceiling tests across 50→100→200→500→1000 client tiers; a paid plan is needed for meaningful BYO pin baselines
BYO register-cid and ipns-publish endpoints return 400 on staging — likely test accounts not configured with BYO mode or endpoint expects different params; pinning to Pinata itself works (p50=718ms)
The browser load test (load-test.spec.ts) measures Playwright/Chromium overhead more than API performance and was removed in favor of the SDK harness which can drive 200 headless clients

cleanup-helpers.ts deleteAccountViaPage derives API URL from page URL hostname, but on staging the app is at app-staging.cipherbox.cc while API is at api-staging.cipherbox.cc — required URL rewriting logic
GitHub Actions load-test workflow needed BYO scenario inputs added and BYO env vars scoped to byo-* scenarios only

code.finding: deleteAccountViaPage derives API URL from page URL — on staging app hostname differs from API hostname, requiring explicit URL rewriting. Also had two page.evaluate() calls that were merged into one for fewer round-trips.
BASE_URL env var support added — config now uses process.env.BASE_URL for baseURL and conditionally skips webServer when not targeting localhost/127.0.0.1
createTestMediaFile needs path.basename() sanitization on filename param to prevent path traversal
Vitest does not auto-load .env files — env vars must be sourced in the shell before running vitest

BYO IPFS inputs (endpoint, protocol, provider label) added as workflow_dispatch inputs with defaults so different providers can be compared per-run; auth token remains as environment secret LOAD_TEST_BYO_AUTH_TOKEN

workflow: Running multiple load tests simultaneously against the same staging instance saturates it and produces misleading 429 errors — always run load tests serially against staging
When cherry-picking commits from worktrees, STATE.md conflicts are expected and should be resolved by taking the worktree version
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code bug fires after all tool calls complete — spot-check via SUMMARY.md existence and git commits to determine real success/failure
Vitest workers inherit env vars from the shell process normally — if env vars appear missing, suspect concurrent resource contention rather than env isolation issues
GSD worktrees commit to their own branch; cherry-pick is needed to bring changes to the phase branch when worktrees are used for parallel plan execution

friction: Worktree cherry-pick process was manual and conflict-prone — STATE.md conflicts required multiple stash/resolve cycles
Two load tests running simultaneously caused misleading 429 errors that looked like a throttle bypass bug, requiring significant debugging time
Vitest not loading .env required shell-level workaround (source .env before running) instead of a clean config solution
Pinata free tier was exhausted during BYO capacity ceiling testing, making the 50→1000 tier results meaningless
1Password SSH signing failures blocked Docker env var inspection during throttle bypass investigation
Git lock file left by a failed worktree caused 34-03 agent to fail on first attempt, requiring manual cleanup
Load test output file was large enough that reading results required targeted grep rather than full file reads
Phase was prematurely marked complete in ROADMAP/STATE before meaningful load baselines were captured, requiring manual reversion
